profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Target
profile.summary:
I want to hear your story. Let's have a virtual coffee chat!  https://lopezjosue.com/30min

I enjoy designing solutions –with people– to make novel changes in the world...

Fun Facts:
— Salvadoran-American 🇸🇻🇺🇸
— First-Generation College Graduate
— Born and raised in South Central Los Angeles
— Goal: Visit every major U.S. city by Winter 2030 (website coming soon!)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Modernize the company's event-driven ecosystem, that processes 1M+ shipping labels daily, from Java to Kotlin, ensuring efficient delivery modes for millions of guests served

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enhance Java Sprint Boot APIs that send 25M+ mobile notifications per day to stores myDevices, improving real-time communication from HQ to Stores, Warehouses, and Fulfillment Centers

Optimized micro-services performance by centralizing a repository layer, reducing redundant database and network calls by 30%, enhancing efficiency and scalability

positions.title: Tech Program Manager
positions.description:
• Agile Team Facilitation
• Product Management
• System Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provisioned 50+ PB of cloud file storage through a scalable RESTful API, enabling engineers to efficiently manage data and scale enterprise systems

Simulated API consumer behavior adding 20 Python functional tests, improving deployment reliability and preemptively identifying integration issues, enhancing overall system stability
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Debugging · Technical Design · Requirements Analysis · Shell Scripting

positions.title: API Engineer
positions.description:
Deployed a Python Flask API that converts 3D-CAD to AR files, reducing conversion time by 20%, accelerating the user experience to under 5 minutes

Improved upload speeds by reducing file processing time by 43% with asyncio multi-threading & multi-processing

Embraced Agile practices: SCRUM, Sprint Planning, Design Thinking
positions.insights: Skills: Datadog · Debugging · Technical Design · Postman · Firebase · Flask · Docker · AWS CloudWatch · Scrum · agile · Agile Application Development · Python · REST API · Application Programming Interfaces (API)

positions.title: Front Desk Attendant
positions.description: managed meetings for 5,800+ Masters, PhD candidates @ Graduate Division

positions.title: Night Desk Attendant
positions.description: On-call dispatch for 1,500+ residents @ 10pm - 4aM, active-listening, ambiguity, clarification

positions.title: ANTrepreneur Center Fellow
positions.description: • assisted business models, market validation, pitching 10 HS students

positions.title: Computer Science Summer Institute, CSSI
positions.description:
• One of 30 students hosted at a residential coding program in Seattle's HQ
• Exposed to (for the first time) command-line, HTML/CSS/JS, and Python
• Developed web app in 3 weeks, showcased project to 50+ Google Engineers
positions.insights: Skills: Application Programming Interfaces (API) · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Bash · Django · jQuery

organizations.name: Management Leadership for Tomorrow
organizations.description: Selected for an 18-month national professional development program for high-achieving diverse college undergraduate talent. Completed business case studies and projects to develop analytical, quantitative, technical, and communication skills. Participated in three professional development conferences hosted by industry leaders, such as Google, Deloitte, Goldman Sachs and more.
